subject: Mitigation cadence: customer trajectory & exec asks (QBR prep)
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mitigation cadence: customer trajectory & exec asks (QBR prep)

Team —

Attaching the first pass of the Halcyon Renewal Risk Register and a short OKR check-in snapshot for the QBR prep. Main asks:

- Please review the risk register and add a single owner per mitigation row (column G). We need owners by EOD Thu so I can fold into the exec memo.
- Call out any delta vs. the OKR metrics (Net Rev Retention, Token throughput, 95th p99 latency) in the right-most notes column.
- Identify any items that should be elevated to the leadership docket (1: immediate exec attention, 2: close monitoring, 3: low).

Quick context: Halcyon showed steady growth in embeddings usage until the May quantization rollout; since then we've observed a 12% increase in token cost and two latency regressions reported by their SRE team. Renewal conversation opens in six weeks.

I'm proposing the following immediate mitigation cadence:
- Today: internal triage (this thread) -> owners assigned
- Wed: data ask to Halcyon (ask below)
- Thu AM: dry run of exec one-pager
- Fri: finalize canary plan & rollback triggers

Data ask to include (I'll send to Lina after we agree): recent token volumes by route, p95/p99 latency before/after quantization, and any recent error spikes or increases in model fallbacks.

Attachments: Halcyon_Renewal_Risk_Register_v1.xlsx; QBR_OKR_checklist_2026Q3.pdf

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor

Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mitigation cadence: customer trajectory & exec asks (QBR prep)

Assigning myself to the latency item (row 7). Initial mitigation plan below:

- Immediate (24 hours): gather traces for the p99 spikes, confirm whether KV cache misses increased post-quantization, and check model variant fallbacks. Owner: Rafael Mendes.
- Short-term (48-72 hours): implement temporary traffic routing to fallback variant with conservative quantization settings for heavy routes. Owner: Rafael + Infra on-call.
- Medium-term (2 weeks): measure end-to-end token cost delta for fallback variant and run A/B to validate user-facing quality. Owner: Rafael + Research.

Also adding the runbook link here: https://runbooks.redwood.com/latency-regressions/2026-quantization

If you want, I can draft the technical paragraph for the exec memo that explains the regression, root-cause hypothesis, and our rollback trigger thresholds.

-Rafael
Senior Technical Account Manager
rafael_mendes@redwood.com

Subject: Re: QBR prep / renewal window

Neha —

Thanks for the heads-up. A few things from our side that will influence the renewal discussion:

- Cost pressure: our finance team saw a ~10% increase MoM on embedding-heavy routes since June. We need a clear plan to bring unit costs back in line.
- Reliability: we've had two days in Aug with elevated p99 that caused timeouts for some storefront flows (attached short error log).
- Contract cadence: procurement wants pricing visibility and a clause for predictable unit pricing before committing.

Happy to run a short technical sync this Thurs if Rafael needs to see trace samples. Procurement can join on Friday for the commercial discussion.

Best,

Subject: RE: Mitigation cadence: customer trajectory & exec asks (QBR prep)

Thanks, all — consolidated update and exec asks below. Please treat this as the single source for the leadership memo I'm pulling together (I'll turn into a one-pager by Fri AM).

Summary (headline): Halcyon renewal is "at-risk" without a short-term cost remediation and a reliability guarantee. Next 10 days are critical.

Top exec asks (to include on the one-pager):
1) Executive engagement: VP-Sales to confirm any pricing levers we can offer if cost normalization isn't achieved by EOD next Friday. Owner: Lauren (action: escalate if cost reconciliation misses target).
2) Technical guarantee: propose a temporary reliability SLO (90-day guardrail) tied to fallback variant with clearly defined rollback triggers. Owner: Rafael (deliverable: technical paragraph + rollback thresholds).
3) Procurement path: a channel for predictable unit pricing (tiered discount + usage banding) to present to Halcyon procurement. Owner: Neha + Lauren (deliverable: draft term sheet).

Immediate next steps:
- Rafael: deliver traces + short technical paragraph by Thu 9/17 2pm PT.
- Lauren: prep escalation bullets and run dry-run Thu 9/17 10:00-10:30 PT.
- Neha: send targeted data ask to Halcyon (will include exact query for token volumes and p95/p99) tonight.

I've attached the current register and OKR checklist. I'll circulate the one-pager Friday morning and request a 20-min leadership readout before the board QBR deck is finalized.

Neha Kapoor
Account Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
